comment: potion.c potionhit() 1685-1688: a potion of oil hitting the hero (isyou). A debug dwarven Archeologist wishes four uncursed potions of oil and throws one straight up: toss_up() lets it fall back on her head and calls potionhit(&youmonst), reaching the POT_OIL case unlit (1685, 1688). She escapes the naming prompt, lights another with apply and throws it up too, so explode_oil() runs (1686-1687), igniting a carried potion; debug mode's Die? prompt is answered n.
